fields.proposed_value: Discovery call with Sofia Martins (Commercial Director) and Andre Pires (Sales Manager). Cedro captures leads on paper, website form and WhatsApp, and leads get lost. They want one place with automatic routing to brokers and calls within two hours. 105 users; budget around USD 60,000 per year; go-live by March 2027. Live demo with sales managers agreed for 12 Nov.
